newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT Q1 net from ord ops lifted by associates.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT Q1 net from ord ops lifted by associates.

text.p: Dutch paper and packaging group KNP BT said on Friday improvements in two associates had helped the company to a slightly improved net profit from ordinary operations.
"Flexible packaging activities performed better, as did Gelderse Papier," a spokesman said.

KNP BT owns 70 percent of paper maker Gelderse Papier which said in March it expected first half 1997 profit to be at least as high as the 5.7 million guilder net in the second half of 1996. It posted a 3.9 million guilder loss in the first half of 1996.
KNP BT's protective and flexible packaging division has been sold to Tenneco for $375 million.
"The formalities were formalised last week," the KNP BT spokesman said.
KNP BT said the sale would be included in its second quarter figures and added this one-off gain would be partly offset by restructuring charges.
KNP BT's first quarter net profit from ordinary operations rose by two million guilders to 52 million guilders.
